labels.text: Section 1(c) as applied for the year: the third lowest rate of the table for unmarried individuals (row 3 of the section 1(c) table, 31 percent, for years before 2018; row 3 of the section 1(j)(2)(C) table, 22 percent, for taxable years beginning after December 31, 2017). Read by the section 3402(q) gambling-winnings withholding of the employment package. Values repeat the rate column of the rate-schedule-1986-unmarried and rate-schedule-tcja-unmarried sidecars.
section 1(c) table: 15, 28, 31, 36, 39.6 percent; the third lowest is 31 percent
section 1(j)(2)(C) table: 10, 12, 22, 24, 32, 35, 37 percent; the third lowest is 22 percent
